response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance) SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count, COUNT(a.link_to_member) * 1.0 / total.attendance_count AS attendance_share FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id CROSS JOIN total WHERE total.attendance_count > 0 GROUP BY e.event_id, total.attendance_count ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, e.event_id LIMIT 10;
